metadata.title: Ribociclib Therapy (Adjuvant) - 28 day
metadata.indication: Ribociclib with an aromatase inhibitor for HR-positive, HER2-negative early breast cancer at high risk of recurrence.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Only entered values are assessed; omitted clinical domains remain explicitly unassessed.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: The usual adjuvant starting dose is ribociclib 400 mg once daily on Days 1–21, followed by Days 22–28 off, for up to three years. The aromatase inhibitor continues every day on its own plan; ovarian suppression is added when indicated.
metadata.source_schedule_interval_label: 28 days; oral targeted treatment on Days 1–21

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

action.recommendation: Relevant hypersensitivity: do not administer; review the responsible component.

rules.explanation: Relevant hypersensitivity: do not administer; review the responsible component.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy/breastfeeding requires treatment exclusion and specialist review.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy/breastfeeding requires treatment exclusion and specialist review.

action.recommendation: Outside the published performance-status population; consultant assessment required.

rules.explanation: Outside the published performance-status population; consultant assessment required.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until ANC recovers to ≥1.0. First uncomplicated grade 3 can resume at the same dose; recurrence, grade 4 or febrile neutropenia requires the lower level after recovery.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until ANC recovers to ≥1.0. First uncomplicated grade 3 can resume at the same dose; recurrence, grade 4 or febrile neutropenia requires the lower level after recovery.

action.recommendation: Treat febrile neutropenia urgently; resume only after recovery at a lower level, or discontinue if reduction below 200 mg would be needed.

rules.explanation: Treat febrile neutropenia urgently; resume only after recovery at a lower level, or discontinue if reduction below 200 mg would be needed.

action.recommendation: The adjuvant source recommends a starting dose of 200 mg in severe renal impairment. Confirm the current dose and clinical context; do not calculate a percentage of the metastatic starting dose.

rules.explanation: The adjuvant source recommends a starting dose of 200 mg in severe renal impairment. Confirm the current dose and clinical context; do not calculate a percentage of the metastatic starting dose.

action.recommendation: The adjuvant source does not provide a separate dialysis dosing schedule. Obtain specialist oncology/pharmacy review.

rules.explanation: The adjuvant source does not provide a separate dialysis dosing schedule. Obtain specialist oncology/pharmacy review.

action.recommendation: The early-breast source requires no starting dose adjustment solely for hepatic impairment. Treatment-emergent liver toxicity is assessed separately.

rules.explanation: The early-breast source requires no starting dose adjustment solely for hepatic impairment. Treatment-emergent liver toxicity is assessed separately.

action.recommendation: Before starting, QTcF must be <450 ms. Correct reversible causes and review interacting medicines.

rules.explanation: Before starting, QTcF must be <450 ms. Correct reversible causes and review interacting medicines.

action.recommendation: Confirm baseline versus ongoing ECG; the initiation and interruption thresholds differ.

rules.explanation: Confirm baseline versus ongoing ECG; the initiation and interruption thresholds differ.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until QTcF <481 ms. First event: same dose after review; recurrence: next lower level. No restart dose is authorised by this abnormal result.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until QTcF <481 ms. First event: same dose after review; recurrence: next lower level. No restart dose is authorised by this abnormal result.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until QTcF <481 ms, then the next lower level only after review. Recurrent >500 ms requires discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until QTcF <481 ms, then the next lower level only after review. Recurrent >500 ms requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Recurrent QTcF >500 ms: discontinue ribociclib.

rules.explanation: Recurrent QTcF >500 ms: discontinue ribociclib.

action.recommendation: The source QT change with serious arrhythmia requires permanent discontinuation and urgent cardiac care.

rules.explanation: The source QT change with serious arrhythmia requires permanent discontinuation and urgent cardiac care.

action.recommendation: Correct/review QT risk and electrolyte abnormalities before treatment; specialist assessment required.

rules.explanation: Correct/review QT risk and electrolyte abnormalities before treatment; specialist assessment required.

action.recommendation: Baseline liver grade is needed. The source treats baseline grade 2 differently; do not assume normal baseline.

rules.explanation: Baseline liver grade is needed. The source treats baseline grade 2 differently; do not assume normal baseline.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until baseline grade recovers. Resume same level after a first event, lower after recurrence.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until baseline grade recovers. Resume same level after a first event, lower after recurrence.

action.recommendation: The isolated grade 2 branch with baseline grade 2 does not require interruption. Assess bilirubin and other hepatic findings separately.

rules.explanation: The isolated grade 2 branch with baseline grade 2 does not require interruption. Assess bilirubin and other hepatic findings separately.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until recovery to baseline or lower, then reduce one level. Recurrent grade 3 requires discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until recovery to baseline or lower, then reduce one level. Recurrent grade 3 requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Recurrent grade 3 liver toxicity: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Recurrent grade 3 liver toxicity: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 liver toxicity: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 liver toxicity: discontinue.

action.recommendation: ALT/AST >3×ULN with bilirubin >2×ULN without cholestasis: discontinue.

rules.explanation: ALT/AST >3×ULN with bilirubin >2×ULN without cholestasis: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Combined liver abnormalities require holding treatment and urgent assessment including cholestasis before a restart decision.

rules.explanation: Combined liver abnormalities require holding treatment and urgent assessment including cholestasis before a restart decision.

action.recommendation: Interrupt and assess ILD. The source describes grade 2 as asymptomatic and recovery <1; reconcile this wording with current SmPC before any lower-dose restart.

rules.explanation: Interrupt and assess ILD. The source describes grade 2 as asymptomatic and recovery <1; reconcile this wording with current SmPC before any lower-dose restart.

action.recommendation: Severe grade 3–4 ILD: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Severe grade 3–4 ILD: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Interrupt until grade ≤1. First occurrence resumes at the same dose; recurrence at the lower dose after review.

rules.explanation: Interrupt until grade ≤1. First occurrence resumes at the same dose; recurrence at the lower dose after review.

action.recommendation: Other grade 4 toxicity: discontinue.

rules.explanation: Other grade 4 toxicity: discontinue.

action.recommendation: Further reduction below 200 mg/day is not permitted.

rules.explanation: Further reduction below 200 mg/day is not permitted.

action.recommendation: The source eligibility includes selected node-negative stage IIA disease, but its exclusion list says node-negative disease. Reconcile this internal conflict before selection.

rules.explanation: The source eligibility includes selected node-negative stage IIA disease, but its exclusion list says node-negative disease. Reconcile this internal conflict before selection.

action.recommendation: Outside the HR-positive/HER2-negative adjuvant source context or prior CDK4/6 exposure: verify eligibility.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
premedication_summary: Routine premedication is not usually required.
Provide prophylactic or rescue antiemetics according to individual risk and local NCCP/NCIS policy.
other_supportive_care: Avoid grapefruit and review QT/CYP3A interactions.
Continue aromatase inhibitor and ovarian suppression where indicated.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00892 current supportive-care section, source checked 2026-10-25; local oral-SACT policy and individual interactions apply.

ctcae_standard.reference: CTCAE grading as cited by the NCCP source protocol
ctcae_standard.display_requirement: Every grade-based input includes toxicity-specific criteria and practical assessment guidance. Do not select a grade from the number alone.

administration.notes: Days 22–28 off ribociclib; endocrine partner continues on its own schedule. Up to three years.
